meta.name: platform-export
meta.description: Cross-platform Godot 4 export — Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS. Prerequisites, export_presets.cfg, CLI commands, and platform gotchas.

copy.tagline: 一键导出 Godot 4 游戏到多平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Godot 4 开发游戏并需要导出到多个平台。
copy.tagline_en: Export Godot 4 games to multiple platforms with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a Godot 4 game and need to export to multiple platforms.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你配置并导出 Godot 4 项目到 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。它会告诉你每个平台需要什么工具、如何设置导出预设，以及运行导出命令。
howto.when: 当你询问如何将 Godot 4 项目导出到多个平台，或遇到导出错误（如 Android 空白配置、iOS 签名问题）时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 Godot 4 项目，导出到 Windows 和 Android。
say.note: Claude 会指导你安装导出模板、创建预设并运行命令。

say.text: 导出到 iOS 时出现签名错误，怎么解决？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through configuring and exporting a Godot 4 project to Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. It explains prerequisites, export_presets.cfg setup, and CLI commands for each platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to export a Godot 4 project to multiple platforms, or encounter export errors like Android blank config or iOS signing issues.

say_en.text: Help me configure a Godot 4 project for Windows and Android export.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through templates, presets, and commands.

say_en.text: How to fix iOS signing errors during export?
say_en.note: Claude checks certificates, provisioning profiles, and bundle ID.
